name: Ludwig Schmidt
bio: Ludwig Schmidt is an assistant professor at Stanford with appointments in computer science and Stanford Data Science, and a member of LAION. Their research covers machine learning datasets, multimodal models, reliable generalization and language models. Schmidt co-authored LAION-5B and DataComp, and is last author of the OpenThoughts paper.
known_for: Co-author of LAION-5B and DataComp datasets
OpenCLIP and OpenFlamingo open-source model code
Last author of OpenThoughts reasoning data recipes
